units.source_text: 且说紫夫人为了天热，很不快适，叫人把头发洗一下。

en.t: Now Lady Murasaki felt very unwell because of the heat, and had someone wash her hair.

units.source_text: 洗过之后，觉得稍稍舒服了。

en.t: After it was washed, she felt a little more comfortable.

units.source_text: 她是躺着洗的，因此头发干得很慢。

en.t: She had it washed while lying down, so her hair dried very slowly.

units.source_text: 虽然不曾好好梳过，但是一丝不乱，光艳可鉴。

en.t: Although it had not been properly combed, not a single strand was out of place, and it shone with a mirrorlike luster.

units.source_text: 身体虽然消瘦，肤色反而洁白可爱，仿佛透明似的，

en.t: Though her body had grown thin, her complexion seemed all the more pure, fair, and lovely, almost transparent,

units.source_text: 容姿之美，世无其类。

en.t: and the beauty of her appearance had no equal in the world.

units.source_text: 然而久病初愈，好比刚刚蜕皮的幼虫，还嫩弱得很。

en.t: Yet she had only just recovered from a long illness, and like a larva newly shed from its skin, she was still very tender and frail.

units.source_text: 二条院多年没有住人，本已略呈荒凉之色，

en.t: Nijo-in had been unoccupied for many years and had already begun to look somewhat desolate,

units.source_text: 自从夫人来此养病之后，来人稠杂，竟有狭隘之感。

en.t: but since the lady had come there to recover, so many people came and went that it even felt cramped.

units.source_text: 源氏直到最近才有余暇注意及此。

en.t: Only recently did Genji have the leisure to notice this.

units.source_text: 他眺望院中布置得异常精雅的池塘和花木，

en.t: He gazed out at the pond and flowering trees in the grounds, arranged with extraordinary refinement,

units.source_text: 觉得心旷神怡，想到：“好容易挨到了今朝！”

en.t: and felt his heart open with relief, thinking, "At last we have managed to reach this morning!"

units.source_text: 池塘上非常凉爽，

en.t: It was very cool over the pond,

units.source_text: 水面开遍荷花，莲叶青青可爱，

en.t: lotus flowers bloomed all across the water, and the green lotus leaves were lovely,

units.source_text: 叶上的露珠像宝玉一般闪闪发光。

en.t: while the dew on the leaves sparkled like jewels.

units.source_text: 紫夫人看了，说道：“请看那莲花！

en.t: Lady Murasaki looked at them and said, "Look at that lotus flower!

units.source_text: 独自在那里乘凉呢。”

en.t: It is cooling itself there all alone."

units.source_text: 她长久不曾起来欣赏景色了，今天实甚难得。

en.t: She had not risen to enjoy the scenery for a long time, so today was truly precious.

units.source_text: 源氏对她说道：“我看到你病起，还疑心是做梦呢。

en.t: Genji said to her, "Seeing you get up after your illness, I still wonder whether I am dreaming.

units.source_text: 真危险啊！

en.t: It was truly dangerous!

units.source_text: 我有好几次想和你一同死了。”

en.t: More than once I thought of dying together with you."

units.source_text: 说时泪盈于睫。

en.t: As he spoke, tears filled his eyelashes.

units.source_text: 紫夫人也不胜感慨，遂吟诗曰：

en.t: Lady Murasaki too was overcome with feeling, and so she recited a poem:
